definition.simple: A basic raw material that is much the same whoever produces it, such as gold, oil, natural gas, wheat or coffee.
definition.balanced: Commodities are often grouped as metals (gold, silver), energy (crude oil, natural gas) and agricultural goods (grains, soft crops, livestock). Their prices move with supply and demand, [[inventory-report|inventories]], [[seasonality]], weather, politics and currencies. Traders can gain exposure through futures contracts, funds or CFDs, each with its own costs and risks.
